name: Zeeb
overview: Zeeb was a male leader of the Midianites during the time of Gideon, as recorded in Judges 7:25. He is noted specifically for his role opposing Gideon and the Israelites. His leadership position highlights his significance as an adversary in this biblical conflict.
namesAndTitles: The name Zeeb is a proper name meaning 'wolf,' which is not indicated as being given by God. This name may reflect characteristics associated with the animal, though the biblical text does not elaborate beyond the meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Zeeb beyond his role as leader of Midian. There are no additional relationships listed in the biblical account.
scriptureSignificance: Zeeb matters in the biblical narrative as a chief opponent of Gideon, representing the Midianite forces that oppressed Israel. His leadership against God's people underscores the challenges Israel faced before deliverance through Gideon. Though his story is brief, it contributes to the larger theme of God's deliverance of Israel from their enemies.
